choices.help: The creator's default and the settings of its measurements: four requests at once (SESS=4) sharing a 262,208-token KV pool, requests up to 262,144 tokens, bit-exact shared-waterfill MTP=2 drafting.
choices.label: Speed

choices.help: Eight requests at once sharing the same 262,208-token KV pool, requests up to 262,144 tokens, and context-parallel KV (GR8_CP=1, experimental upstream).
choices.label: More sessions

choices.help: Strict MTP=1 drafting without the shared waterfill, four requests at once. The creator measured 44.5 / 60.8 / 74.2 tok/s at 1 / 2 / 4 streams, against 47.9 / 66.6 / 79.8 for speed.
choices.label: Quality

options.help: What to prioritize (the creator's TUNE). It sets the number of requests that decode at once, the drafting and, for long context, context-parallel KV; every choice reads the release's K4 width.
options.label: Priority
options.name: tune

choices.help: No vision tower (the creator's default; gr8's GR8_GLM53F_VISION=0).
choices.label: Text only

choices.help: Each box loads the BF16 vision tower (about 1.1 GB of weights and its workspace a box) and the API takes images. The creator ships it untested with this recipe.
choices.label: Images

options.help: Whether each box loads the release's vision tower so the API takes images (the creator's opt-in GR8_GLM53F_VISION=1 in EXTRA_ENV, untested by the creator with this recipe).
options.label: Image input
options.name: vision

choices.help: The loader reads the release's files as they are (the creator's default).
choices.label: Off

choices.help: The first start writes the copies (the creator's prepare step, 170 s a box in its run), later starts read them.
choices.label: On

options.help: Dense per-rank copies of each box's expert ranges, written once to the writable cache and read by the loader in place of the release's sparse files (the creator's GR8_LOAD_COMPACT with GR8_LOAD_MERGE_KB=1). The creator measured a boot from a cold disk in 18.6 / 18.5 s against 29.4 / 29.0 s without, with the same tokens on 10 of 10 greedy prompts. Needs about 72.8 GiB of disk a box.
options.label: Compact expert copies
options.name: compact
